testcase.name: retains the cloud root until local cleanup is verified, then finalizes and does not wrap twice
refused preflight cannot prepare or delete cloud data
partial device failure keeps the cloud root; retry completes from the durable receipt
unsupported external cleanup preserves the root and asks the shell to cancel only after cloud proof
server completion refusal cancels fresh preflight without local purge or cloud finalization
restart retry preserves unverified pending receipts and never asks cloud to finalize
